### Skimming the Surface
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/day-by-day-oct-11-12-2008-11582820.html
Passage: Job 11:7-8
Points:
- Busy religious routines often substitute for a genuine search into the depths of God.
- Modern culture mistakenly equates maturity with ease and visible success rather than God's glory.
- Spiritual transformation takes place when believers remain steadfast through afflictions instead of fleeing them.
- Each person must honestly reflect on whether they are truly knowing God or merely gliding along the surface.
